faq.header_subtitle: Still confused? Find the answers here.
faq.q1: Do I have to use my real name?
faq.a1: Not necessarily, whatever you are comfortable with. You can use your real name if you want your friends to know it's you, or use initials/pseudonym if you want to be more private and mysterious.
faq.q2: How do I reply to a message I like?
faq.a2: Here music is the main language. You can respond to messages by sending a Song Reply via Deezer that represents your feelings, optionally with a short text message.
faq.q3: Can Admin see who sent the message?
faq.a3: No. We implement a Blind Moderation system. When reviewing messages, the sender's identity is hidden from moderators. We only judge the content, not the person.
faq.q4: What if I find inappropriate messages?
faq.a4: We implement an Automatic Word Filter when creating messages. However, if negative content still slips through, you can report it via the form in the About menu (Footer). Select the 'Report Content' category and our team will follow up immediately.
faq.q5: Why did my message suddenly disappear?
faq.a5: For mutual comfort, Admin actively moderates content. If your message is gone, please check the Notifications menu. Our system will surely send info on the reason for the message deletion.
faq.q6: Why can't I reply to other people's 'replies'?
faq.a6: We apply the 'One-Way Tribute' concept. The goal is to keep interactions simple, focus on song appreciation, and avoid unnecessary long debates.
faq.q7: Do I need a Premium account to play songs?
faq.a7: No need! Thanks to Deezer integration, anyone can listen to a 30-second song snippet (preview) for free without needing to login or subscribe to any music app.
faq.q8: Why does the song only play for 30 seconds?
faq.a8: This is the international standard for Audio Preview allowed by music labels for free. Since Resonate is not a paid streaming app (like Spotify/Deezer Premium), we are only allowed to play 30-second snippets to respect musician copyrights.
faq.q9: Why can't I find the song I'm looking for?
faq.a9: The song collection on Resonate is connected directly in real-time with the Deezer database. If your favorite song doesn't appear, it's likely not available in their catalog yet. This is beyond our control, thank you for understanding!
faq.a10:
We understand that Spotify is many people's favorite platform. However, currently, new integration access is temporarily suspended by Spotify for system maintenance.

To keep the song preview feature running smoothly, we are currently using Deezer. Don't worry! If Spotify access is reopened, we plan to support both platforms simultaneously so your music search is maximized and limitless.
faq.q11: My account is restricted/banned, what's the solution?
faq.a11: We take strict action against community violations. However, if you feel this sanction is a mistake, you can file an Appeal directly through the app. Our team will review your account status.
faq.q12: Can I change my appearance or delete my account?
faq.a12: Of course. You can change the card theme and profile photo (avatar) as you like. If you want to quit, there is also an option to permanently delete your account in the profile settings.

about.title: About Resonate
about.desc_1: Resonate was born from a simple realization: sometimes, words alone are not enough to represent what we feel.
about.desc_2: We believe that every feeling deserves to be heard. Whether it's an unsent love letter, a heavy heart, or just a joke to entertain yourself. However, text often feels flat. That's why here, words are combined with music.

features.amplify_desc: Music is a universal language. By embedding songs from Deezer, your message is not only read, but also "felt".
features.judgment_desc: Through the Anonymous feature, we create a safe space. You are free to be yourself without worrying about identity.
features.trace_desc: Think of this as your emotional journal. A place where visual and audio memories are stored neatly for the future.
